name: io.github.SportApi-net/sportapi-mcp
title: SportAPI
description: Live and Prematch sports odds, scores and statistics from SportAPI. Demo data without a key.

environmentVariables.name: SPORTAPI_KEY
environmentVariables.description: SportAPI key, sent in the Package header. Leave unset for demo data.

environmentVariables.name: SPORTAPI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your personal SportAPI base URL, e.g. https://YOUR_API_DOMAIN. Leave unset for demo data.

environmentVariables.name: SPORTAPI_LANGUAGE
environmentVariables.description: Response language code enabled for your key.
